Re: 

Briefing Schedule in No.  18-1059, Kelly v. United States 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent Petitioner in Kelly v.  United States,  granted on June 28, 2019. I  am writing to 
respectfully request that the Court adopt a briefing schedule that makes Petitioner's opening brief 
due September 17, Respondent's brief due November 22, and Petitioner's reply due December 23. 
The  Solicitor  General,  counsel  for  Respondent,  has  agreed  to  this  proposed  schedule,  which 
accommodates both the government's commitments and mine. This schedule  will allow the case 
to be fully briefed before the Court' s January sitting. 

Without any change to the briefing schedule,  Petitioner's brief would  be  due August  12, 

Respondent's would be due September 11 , and Petitioner's reply would be due on October 11. 

Sincerely, 

~'RA 

Yaakov M. Roth
